name: com.hyxen.adlocusaar.geofence.GeofenceService
description: The HyXen AdLocus ad SDK uses this background service for adding and removing monitored regions and checking location changes in earlier releases; the latest analyzed release has no active work here.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops location-triggered AdLocus events in releases with geofence handling; it makes no visible difference in the latest analyzed release.
